_comment: Canned results for AGENT_MODE=scripted (local demo, no model). Keyed by Defender incident id. Each entry runs board lookups through MCP (so they show in the audit log), then posts a finding, IOCs and a verdict in the incident thread, then requests one action that waits for a human.

1001.hunt: EmailUrlInfo | where Url has 'contoso-payroll-update.example' | summarize recipients = dcount(NetworkMessageId)

finding.body: **Credential phishing, one recipient, link not yet clicked.** The sender domain `contoso-payroll-update.example` is a look-alike registered this week. Only ana.lopez@contoso.com received it (hunting: 1 message). URL detonation flagged the landing page as a fake sign-in form. No sign-ins from new locations for Ana since delivery.

payload.evidence: EmailUrlInfo hunt, URL detonation verdict, user lookup

action.justification: Confirmed credential-phishing message (look-alike payroll domain, fake sign-in page per URL detonation) still in one mailbox. Soft delete removes it before it is clicked.

1002.hunt: DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteIP == '203.0.113.77' | summarize devices = dcount(DeviceId)

finding.body: **Malicious script ran on ws-0142, contained to one device so far.** `update-check.ps1` was fetched from `cdn-update-check.example` by an encoded PowerShell command and has no prevalence in the tenant. The device then connected to 203.0.113.77, which no other device has contacted (hunting: 1 device). The machine is a finance workstation with high exposure in MDE.

payload.evidence: device and file lookups, DeviceNetworkEvents hunt

action.justification: Unknown script executed via an encoded PowerShell download cradle, followed by a connection to a rare external IP. Selective isolation keeps Outlook and Teams working while we collect evidence.

1003.hunt: SigninLogs | where UserPrincipalName == 'j.chen@contoso.com' | summarize countries = dcount(Location) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

finding.body: **Likely account compromise: the Amsterdam sign-in used a legacy client and a hosting-provider IP.** Jordan signed in from Sydney on a managed device, then 20 minutes later from 203.0.113.200 (a hosting range, not a VPN Contoso uses) with IMAP. No MFA was performed on the second sign-in. I could not see mailbox rule changes: someone with Exchange access should check.

payload.evidence: user lookup, IP lookup, SigninLogs hunt

1003.question: @analyst can you check whether j.chen@contoso.com has new inbox rules or forwarding? I can't see Exchange.

action.justification: Second sign-in from a hosting-provider IP over legacy IMAP 20 minutes after a Sydney sign-in, with no MFA. Revoking sessions cuts off any stolen refresh token.

mention_reply: Thanks for the mention. I'm the scripted demo agent: I replay canned results and can't investigate new questions. In a real deployment Claude would answer here.
